title.en: Log in with an identity provider (OAuth)

concept.hr: Tko što vidi: preglednik, aplikacija, davatelj identiteta
concept.en: Who sees what: browser, app, identity provider

summary.hr: Prijava kodom i PKCE korak po korak: lozinku vidi samo davatelj identiteta, kod ide kroz preglednik, a žetoni mimo njega.
summary.en: Step a log-in with an authorization code and PKCE: only the identity provider sees the password, the code passes through the browser, the tokens do not.
